title: Exfoliation of the whole body
text:
The location, unique, in the heart of Passeig de Gracia, on the same block as the building of La Pedrera.
Very helpful and helpful staff. It is rating that they are of Thai origin and bring this type of Service and treatment to customers in their culture. 
The very well-conditioned rooms and all with shower inside the room, to be able to shower after the Exfoliation Processing.
The aroma of the product very pleasant, with a smell of melon.
Overall, a very pleasant experience that I recommend to all people who come to Barcelona.

title: Facial Exfoliation

title: Exfoliating Processing Whole Body
text: I let myself be recommended by the Centre’s Thai receptionist saying I was looking for an exfoliating massage, and she recommended the 50-minute Body Scrab. I was very happy with the Service and the place. The kindness of the Thai community is exceptional, always with a smile. I'm sure I'll repeat. Thanks for everything
author: Z1773ALfrankb

title: Whole Body Exfoliating Processing
text: I had rough skin and was recommended for Body Scrab Exfoliating Processing. I really came out with baby-like, super-soft skin. After Processing, and a shower, they finished with 15 minutes of aromatic massage with essential oils of jasmine. I was recommended to let the oil work on my skin for 2 hours without showering again to penetrate further. I was very happy with the Processing and Service
